name: Glue Pot
text: Start each round with a free Duct Tape (it vanishes at round end).

name: Coin Press
text: +2 currency at the end of each round.

name: Magnifier
text: Hidden blueprint requirements are always shown.

name: Sorting Tray
text: Start each round with an extra card in hand (+1 hand size) and +1 draw.

name: Salvage Rig
text: +1 currency whenever you complete a build.

name: Spare Reel
text: Start each round with a free Adaptor (it vanishes at round end).
